title: Null-flag prolongation of distributions of type F4 or split real F4
source_version: Official SIGMA 21 (2025) journal PDF and native TeX; acquired 2026-09-30; exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The prolongation is recovered from singular extremals, not chosen by its symbol: Hamiltonian constraints identify a null velocity cone, null flags organize its incidence geometry, and the successive derived distribution realizes the full eleven-step growth sequence. The Cartan-model calculation and transfer to arbitrary type-F4 distributions are both retained.
author: Goo Ishikawa; Yoshinori Machida
